faq.q: How much does Knapp & Roberts charge?
faq.a: Knapp & Roberts publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Knapp & Roberts offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Knapp & Roberts publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Knapp & Roberts have offices?
faq.a: Knapp & Roberts publishes two offices, in Scottsdale and Phoenix. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Knapp & Roberts?
faq.a: Knapp & Roberts names 14 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Knapp & Roberts publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Knapp & Roberts publishes 18 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

json_ld_descriptions: The Phoenix personal injury attorneys at Knapp & Roberts have served Maricopa County for over 20 years. Founding partner Craig Knapp has been voted Lawyer of the Year for 2018 and Dana Roberts has been consistently selected as a SuperLawyer by her peers. The firm Knapp & Roberts was voted one of the Best Law Firms for 2018 by U.S. News and World Report, and strives to maintain the highest level of professional standards possible. If you have been involved in an accident in Phoenix, or have found yourself as the victim of medical malpractice – Knapp & Roberts can help! Call us today to see how one of our award-winning attorneys can help you (480) 991-7677.

At Knapp & Roberts, our Phoenix medical malpractice lawyers fight for victims of medical negligence, including surgical errors, misdiagnoses, and birth injuries. We also serve as Phoenix elder abuse lawyers, protecting seniors from mistreatment in nursing homes. Our firm is dedicated to securing justice and compensation for those harmed by negligence while working to prevent future tragedies. With decades of experience, we represent clients across Arizona, including Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Mesa. Contact Knapp & Roberts today at 480.991.7677 for a free consultation—we are here to make a difference.
